basic_info.description: Step into this stunning, light-filled corner flat, featuring soaring ceilings, skylights, and beautiful hardwood floors. This spacious Noe Valley home boasts 4 large bedrooms, plus a flexible fifth room that can be used as an office or additional living space. Recently renovated, it offers three updated bathrooms, an attached garage for convenient parking, and in-unit laundry for added ease. With its perfect blend of classic San Francisco architecture and modern amenities, this home invites you to experience both comfort and style. Located just a short walk from Church Street's vibrant cafes, restaurants, schools, and public transportation, it's the perfect spot for city living. Buyers are encouraged to explore the potential for fast-track condo conversion!
